name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.2

  • Sticky order summary now appears for the full ASBO workflow, including Intro.
  • Made product ordering more compact across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Moved large product imagery, description, garment specifications, and size information into an on-demand product-details modal.
  • Only one product accordion stays open at a time on all viewport sizes.
  • Added a 1+ pricing level using the current WooCommerce product or variation price below the first configured ASBO bulk tier.
  • Fixed estimated totals and checkout pricing for pre-bulk-tier quantities.
  • Added Total Saved, including live volume savings, $15 digitizing savings at the configured threshold, and configured shipping savings at the free-shipping threshold.
  • Added Gutenberg controls for savings label and incentive dollar values.
  • Fixed the Selected Total product-row label and preserved SanMar, S&S Activewear, Momentec, and multi-supplier compatibility.
